s: I am Maya, and I am here with Lena.
Today we are talking about colors.
Colors are all around us, and colors can change how we feel.
A bright morning can feel happy.
A dark evening can feel calm.
What is your favorite color, Maya?
When I see the blue sky, I feel free and happy.
But I also love a dark blue night sky full of stars.
It gets dark early in winter.
A dark room with one small warm light can feel very cozy.
And dark is not only for the night.
Do you like dark chocolate, Lena?
When I eat it, I feel happy.
Food colors make us feel hungry.
We feel hungry before we eat, because the food looks delicious.
What do you feel when you see green, Lena?
I feel calm and fresh when I see green trees.
I love to walk in a green park and feel the cool air.
Let me tell you a small story.
Yesterday I was in the park, and I lost my ring.
My ring is small, and the grass is dark green.
It was very hard to see!
I saw something bright in the dark grass.
I am so happy for you!
A ring is small, but we feel sad when we lose it.
Now I clean my ring every week.
A bright clean ring makes me feel happy every day.

Maya, tell me more about colors and feelings.
My little cousin loves to draw.
She draws with many bright colors, and her pictures are happy and full of life.
Does she use a rubber when she makes a mistake?
She uses a rubber all the time.
She draws a blue sky, and then she uses her rubber to fix one line.
Her rubber is pink and very small.
I feel nervous when I draw without a rubber.
But with a rubber, I feel free.
I can try and try again!
She erased a dark line with her rubber, and then she drew a bright yellow sun.
When her picture is finished, she says, I feel proud!
She can feel proud because she worked very hard.
Now, friends, think of your favorite color.
How do you feel when you see it?
I feel happy when I see blue.
I feel calm when I see green.
I feel warm and cozy when I see orange.

We feel many things when we see colors.
And a rubber helps us fix mistakes.
Let us say our five words one more time.
Look at the colors around you and use these five words!
